cards.d: The altitude of a place is its height above sea level.
cards.e: The air was thin at such a high altitude on the mountain.

cards.d: A coastline is the outline of a country’s coast.
cards.e: He noticed that most of the cities in Australia are on the coastline.

cards.d: To deter means to prevent or discourage someone from doing something.
cards.e: Icy roads deter people from driving their cars.

cards.d: To devise something means to have an idea or plan about it in the mind.
cards.e: The thieves devised a plan to steal the diamonds.

cards.d: Expertise is the knowledge and skills to do something well.
cards.e: John has a lot of advertising expertise. He can sell anything!

cards.d: A fracture is a crack or break in something.
cards.e: Don’t stand on that leg because there is a fracture. It might get worse.

cards.d: To impair something means to damage it or make it worse.
cards.e: Drinking coffee impairs my ability to go to sleep.

cards.d: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.
cards.e: The school decided to implement a new teaching strategy.

cards.d: If something is indigenous, it is originally from, or native to, a place.
cards.e: Tomatoes are indigenous to the Americas.

cards.d: Insight is a deep and accurate understanding of something.
cards.e: The physics textbook gave the student new insight about gravity.

cards.d: A limb is a large branch on a tree.
cards.e: The monkey sat on the tree limb and enjoyed a piece of fruit.

cards.d: A migraine is a painful headache that makes one feel sick.
cards.e: My sister gets a migraine every time she has a lot of stress.

cards.d: Optimism is the feeling of being hopeful about the future or success of something.
cards.e: The mother had optimism about her children’s futures.

cards.d: When something is peculiar, it is strange, sometimes in a bad way.
cards.e: That peculiar smell coming from the kitchen reminds me of rotten eggs.

cards.d: When a person is proficient at something, they can do it well.
cards.e: Secretaries are proficient at typing quickly.

cards.d: A quest is a long and difficult search for something.
cards.e: The treasure hunter went on a quest to find an ancient gold necklace.

cards.d: A ridge is a long, narrow piece of raised land.
cards.e: The brown bear walked along the edge of the mountain ridge.

cards.d: A spouse is the person to whom someone is married.
cards.e: I live in a home with my spouse and our two children.

cards.d: To thrust means to push or move something quickly with a lot of force.
cards.e: The boxer thrust his fist into the punching bag.

cards.d: To tolerate something means to be able to accept it even when it is unpleasant.
cards.e: When you are in a hurry, it can be hard to tolerate traffic signals.
